description: To rename someone already on the roster, pass rename_staff_id with the new name; the old spelling keeps pointing at them. Otherwise adds a field worker to the roster, as the staff page's Add staff does: name (a profile with that name is reused, never duplicated), optional employment_type (employee or contractor), or client_id to make an existing contact staff (a name clash comes back as name_conflict; call again with link_to_staff_id to link instead). This gives them no sign-in; inviting someone to Sergio is the owner's. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.
